keys.why: The app's backend and database live in Supabase; this is the project address the app talks to.
keys.howToGet: Supabase dashboard → your project → Project Settings → API → Project URL

keys.why: The PUBLIC key the app ships with to reach Supabase — safe to include, protected by row-level security.
keys.howToGet: Same page → API keys → publishable key (starts with sb_publishable_)
